facts.text: Billy Bones never paid for a single one.
facts.why: Billy Bones is the lodger who tells Jim pirate tales, then gives him the map and dies after Blind Pew gives him the black spot. Nothing in the sources says he never paid.
facts.fix: Billy Bones told his pirate tales over one of these, right up until Blind Pew turned up.

vibe.verdict: The Benbow Inn parchment is right for the film and Kermit's note is spot on, but it leaves out the songs and the best gags, and the poster sits in black bars.
missing: Black spot delivered by Blind Pew (inn)
Mr Arrow plays his own ghost (Hispaniola)
Silver and Jim's friendship, compass returned (island)
ideas: Swap 'Billy Bones' Benbow Inn steak and mushroom pie' note for the black spot line.
Rename 'Long John's galley fish stew' to 'Long John's galley stew, cook's special' and add that Silver is the cook the captain did not check.
Replace the 'Warm buttered milk' note with Mrs Bluveridge hearing every word from the next room.
Add a 'Black spot' chocolate disc to the brownies.
